signals.title: Codex keeps Guardian classifier policy instructions uncapped unless a limit is explicit
signals.title_zh: Codex 仅在显式配置上限时才截断 Guardian 分类器策略指令
signals.summary: Guardian v2 no longer applies an implicit token cap to classifier instructions when no cap was configured, avoiding silent truncation of rendered policy while still honoring explicit local or model limits.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian v2 在未配置上限时不再隐式限制分类器指令 Token，避免已渲染策略被静默截断；若本地或模型显式配置上限仍会遵守。

signals.title: Codex restricts macOS preference reads to full-disk sandbox policies
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 macOS 偏好设置读取权限限制在全盘读取沙箱策略
signals.summary: Seatbelt preference and cfprefsd grants are now included only when filesystem reads are unrestricted, preventing macOS preferences from exposing data outside restricted read roots.
signals.summary_zh: Seatbelt 偏好设置与 cfprefsd 授权现在仅在文件系统读取不受限时启用，防止 macOS 偏好服务越过受限读取根暴露数据。

signals.title: Codex routes Amazon Bedrock compaction through Responses compaction triggers
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Amazon Bedrock 压缩统一到 Responses compaction trigger
signals.summary: Amazon Bedrock remote compaction now uses compaction_trigger items sent through /v1/responses and provider capabilities explicitly opt in to remote compaction, with manual and automatic history tests.
signals.summary_zh: Amazon Bedrock 远程压缩改为通过 /v1/responses 发送 compaction_trigger，并由 Provider Capability 显式声明支持；同时覆盖手动与自动压缩历史测试。

signals.title: Codex pins Amazon Bedrock models to Multi-Agent V1 capability
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Amazon Bedrock 模型能力固定到 Multi-Agent V1
signals.summary: Bedrock model catalogs now advertise MultiAgentVersion V1 because Bedrock lacks response items required by V2, making multi-agent protocol capability a provider-specific compatibility decision.
signals.summary_zh: 由于 Bedrock 不支持 Multi-Agent V2 所需的 response items，其模型目录现在显式声明 MultiAgentVersion V1，把多 Agent 协议能力作为 Provider 级兼容性决策。

signals.title: Codex serializes host-supplied exec-server WebSocket replacement and session recovery
signals.title_zh: Codex 串行化宿主提供的 Exec Server WebSocket 替换与会话恢复
signals.summary: Embedding hosts can supply already accepted authenticated WebSockets and replace them while resuming the same exec-server session; overlapping replacements are rejected and failed or cancelled handoff claims are released.
signals.summary_zh: 宿主可提供已接受且认证的 WebSocket，并在保持同一 Exec Server 会话的前提下替换连接；重叠替换会被拒绝，失败或取消的 Handoff Claim 会被释放。

signals.title: Codex bounds retry of transient environment-registry failures during initial exec connection
signals.title_zh: Codex 对首次 Exec 连接中的临时环境注册表失败实施有界重试
signals.summary: Initial Noise rendezvous now retries only transient registry failures with per-request and overall deadlines, backoff and retry limits, while permanent and malformed responses terminate immediately.
signals.summary_zh: 首次 Noise Rendezvous 仅对临时 Registry 失败执行带单次/总体截止时间、退避与次数上限的重试；永久错误和完整但畸形的响应立即终止。

signals.title: Codex adds ownership-scoped MCP event streaming to app-server
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 App Server 增加受所有权约束的 MCP 事件流
signals.summary: Experimental MCP event streams are scoped to the owning app-server connection and thread, enforce unique IDs and per-connection limits, clean up on unsubscribe/close, wait for active notification, and stop when authentication or runtime ownership changes.
signals.summary_zh: 实验性 MCP 事件流按 App Server 连接与 Thread 所有权隔离，实施唯一 ID 与单连接上限，在退订/关闭时清理，等待 Active 通知，并在认证或 Runtime 所有权变化时终止。

signals.title: Codex preserves managed developer instructions across compaction, resume and forks
signals.title_zh: Codex 在压缩、恢复与 Agent Fork 中保持托管开发者指令
signals.summary: Managed additional developer instructions are now a separate requirements layer, emit replacement/removal context updates, survive compaction, resume and agent forks without duplication, and are rejected above a 10,000-token estimate.
signals.summary_zh: 托管 additional developer instructions 成为独立 Requirements 层；变化时显式发出替换/移除上下文，跨 Compaction、Resume 与 Agent Fork 保持且不重复，并对超过约 10,000 Token 的内容拒收。

signals.title: Codex marks standalone tool outputs as external context that can disable memory
signals.title_zh: Codex 将独立 Tool Output 标记为可禁用记忆的外部上下文
signals.summary: Standalone function outputs without call IDs are treated as external context in injected, new and forked threads; when configured, this marks memory mode polluted and disables memory, and Guardian transcripts retain namespaced tool identity.
signals.summary_zh: 没有 call_id 的独立 Function Output 在注入、新建与 Fork Thread 中被视为外部上下文；启用相关策略时会把 Memory Mode 标记为污染并禁用记忆，Guardian Transcript 仍保留命名空间化工具身份。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK fails closed on empty tool arguments
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 对空 Tool Arguments 采用 Fail-Closed
signals.summary: The Agents SDK core now rejects empty tool arguments rather than allowing an ambiguous empty invocation to proceed, tightening tool-call admission semantics.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK Core 现在拒绝空 Tool Arguments，而不是让语义不明确的空调用继续执行，从而收紧工具调用准入语义。

signals.title: Google ADK isolates invalid skill catalog entries instead of failing the entire search
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 隔离无效 Skill Catalog 条目而不是让整次搜索失败
signals.summary: Skill search now skips and warns on catalog hits with invalid frontmatter, non-string names or empty descriptions, preventing one malformed external entry from collapsing discovery for all results.
signals.summary_zh: Skill Search 遇到 Frontmatter 不合法、名称非字符串或描述为空的 Catalog Hit 时改为跳过并告警，避免一个外部畸形条目导致整次 Discovery 失败。

signals.title: Google ADK makes Workflow runs honor before-run early exit
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 让 Workflow Run 正确遵守 Before-Run 提前退出
signals.summary: Workflow execution now captures before_run_callback results and terminates when it returns Content, matching the non-workflow path and restoring a control hook that can veto further execution.
signals.summary_zh: Workflow 执行现在会获取 before_run_callback 的返回值，并在其返回 Content 时提前结束，与非 Workflow 路径一致，恢复可阻止后续执行的控制 Hook。

signals.title: Google ADK allows distinct injected LLM clients per agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 支持为不同 Agent 注入独立 LLM Client
signals.summary: Gemini and AnthropicLlm can receive preconfigured custom clients, explicitly supporting multi-agent systems in which different agents use distinct client configuration and provider behavior.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini 与 AnthropicLlm 可注入预配置的自定义 Client，显式支持多 Agent 系统为不同 Agent 使用不同 Client 配置与 Provider 行为。

signals.title: Google ADK exposes a runtime cap for maximum LLM calls
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 增加最大 LLM 调用次数的运行时上限
signals.summary: ADK adds ADK_MAX_LLM_CALLS as an environment-configurable limit for maximum LLM calls, turning an execution-cost and runaway-loop boundary into explicit runtime configuration.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 新增 ADK_MAX_LLM_CALLS 环境变量配置最大 LLM 调用次数，把执行成本与失控循环边界变成显式 Runtime 配置。

signals.title: Google ADK reverts a transport-based A2A HITL guard that blocked legitimate confirmations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 回退会误阻合法确认的 A2A 传输层 HITL 门禁
signals.summary: ADK reverted a guard that discarded every A2A human tool confirmation because the transport carried A2A metadata; the maintainer notes the control was both overbroad and insufficient because approval trust must bind to the approving principal rather than transport alone.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 回退了一个因请求带 A2A Metadata 而丢弃全部 A2A 人工工具确认的门禁；维护者明确指出该控制既过宽又不足，因为审批可信性应绑定批准主体，而不能只绑定传输通道。

signals.title: Google ADK scopes RemoteA2A authentication credentials per agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 RemoteA2A 认证凭据按 Agent 隔离
signals.summary: RemoteA2aAgent now accepts auth schemes and credentials resolved once per invocation; interceptors and derived credential keys are per agent so one agent's token cannot reach another agent's host, and tokenless OAuth no longer sends Bearer None.
signals.summary_zh: RemoteA2aAgent 现在支持每次调用解析一次的 Auth Scheme 与 Credential；Interceptor 与派生 Credential Key 按 Agent 隔离，避免一个 Agent 的 Token 泄露到另一 Agent Host，同时不再为无 Token OAuth 发送 Bearer None。

signals.title: Claude Code adds bounded graceful shutdown for self-hosted runners
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 为自托管 Runner 增加有界优雅关闭
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.238 adds a deferred-shutdown maximum: on SIGTERM a runner keeps serving attached sessions, parks remaining work after a configured number of minutes, then exits.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.238 新增 Deferred Shutdown 最大时长：Runner 收到 SIGTERM 后继续服务已附着会话，达到配置分钟数后将剩余工作 Park，再退出。

signals.title: Claude Code prevents healthy runner handoff after one slow or lost poll
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 防止一次慢轮询或丢失轮询触发健康 Runner 错误交接
signals.summary: Self-hosted runners are no longer removed by the server after a single slow or lost poll request, avoiding transfer of a still-healthy session to another runner.
signals.summary_zh: 自托管 Runner 不再因为一次慢轮询或轮询丢失就被服务端移除，从而避免仍健康的 Session 被错误转交到另一个 Runner。

signals.title: Claude Code makes cross-session refusal and queue loss visible to senders
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将跨会话拒收与队列丢弃显式反馈给发送方
signals.summary: Cross-session SendMessage now reports explicit refusal and inbox drops caused by rate limits or full queues instead of acknowledging silent loss, strengthening delivery outcome semantics.
signals.summary_zh: 跨会话 SendMessage 现在会明确报告接收方拒绝以及因限流/队列满造成的 Inbox 丢弃，而不是把消息静默丢失后仍表现为成功，从而强化交付终态语义。

signals.title: Claude Code gates project MCP header helpers on folder trust and strips inherited credentials
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 以 Folder Trust 门禁项目 MCP Header Helper 并剥离继承凭据
signals.summary: Project MCP headersHelper and inline MCP servers now require accepted folder trust, while helpers from project, plugin or agent files run without inherited credential environment variables; higher-scope helpers run from the Claude config directory.
signals.summary_zh: 项目 MCP headersHelper 与 Inline MCP Server 现在要求先接受 Folder Trust；来自项目、Plugin 或 Agent File 的 Helper 运行时不继承 Credential 环境变量，高层级 Helper 则从 Claude Config 目录执行。

signals.title: Claude Code hides pre-warmed idle workers until a task claims them
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在任务 Claim 前隐藏预热空闲 Worker
signals.summary: ListAgents and SendMessage no longer expose the idle worker pre-warmed for the next background session; that worker becomes visible only after a task actually claims it.
signals.summary_zh: ListAgents 与 SendMessage 不再暴露为下一后台 Session 预热的空闲 Worker；只有任务真正 Claim 后，该 Worker 才进入可见状态。

signals.title: Claude Code makes crashed Remote Control sessions reusable and tolerates brief reconnect refusals
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让崩溃的 Remote Control Session 可复用并容忍短暂重连拒绝
signals.summary: A Remote Control session whose process crashes can now be reused on the next message, and brief 403 refusals from network edges, VPNs or proxies are tolerated for up to three minutes before a persistent block is reported.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Control Session 的进程崩溃后，现在可在下一条消息到来时复用；网络边缘、VPN 或代理造成的短暂 403 最多容忍 3 分钟，持续阻塞才被明确报告。

signals.title: Gemini CLI makes ignore-path symlink evaluation consistent
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 统一 Ignore Path 的符号链接求值语义
signals.summary: Gemini CLI fixes inconsistent symlink evaluation in ignore-path handling, tightening the correspondence between configured ignored paths and filesystem objects reached through links.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 修复 Ignore Path 处理中符号链接求值不一致的问题，使已配置忽略路径与通过 Link 实际访问到的文件系统对象保持一致语义。

signals.title: Claude Code releases old subagent tool results from long interactive sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在长交互 Session 中释放已离开显示窗口的 Subagent Tool Result
signals.summary: Subagent tool results are now released after leaving the recent display window, fixing unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions without changing the current visible result window.
signals.summary_zh: Subagent Tool Result 离开最近显示窗口后会被释放，修复长交互 Session 的无界内存增长，同时不改变当前可见结果窗口。
